authorization: All eight P04 science operations require an authenticated principal and active organization membership. Dataset-read is required for method and codebook reads; research-plan is required for templates, policies and validation. organization_id is an explicit query field for reads and a body field for validation so the server can resolve the tenant and intersect token and role scopes.
method_visibility: Only exact approved method versions appear. No production approval bundle is configured by default, so lists are empty and detail lookups return 404 until human scientific review is recorded.
singular_policy_and_codebook: The API design names singular response DTOs while marking method/version and source/variable filters optional. This implementation requires the exact identifying pair and returns 422 when omitted, avoiding an arbitrary default selection or cross-source policy ambiguity.
recipe_validation: Static method and stored catalog-version metadata checks only. A source-compatible response remains requires_source_validation and scientific_finding=false; the result does not prove coverage, uncertainty, fresh acquisition or a supported SST claim.
approval_activation: An operator explicitly configures ORCA_SCIENCE_APPROVAL_BUNDLE_FILE only after checking an identifiable human review attestation. The loader verifies its bytes, exact method and policy, and SHA-256 digests of all reviewed science modules. It cannot itself establish the reviewer's professional identity.
open_acceptance: Written independent scientific approval of method, QC, thresholds, tolerances and claim language
